policy_validity.effective_date_basis: The official pages did not state a policy start date; this snapshot is supported only from the observed-active date and must not be back-cast.

sources.title: TMLR Submission Guidelines and Editorial Policies

unresolved_conflicts: The reviewed pages do not state a general confidentiality rule for reviewers using external LLM services; double-blind and staged public-review requirements still apply, so live confidentiality checking remains required before processing unpublished content.

acceptance_objective.rule: Claims must be supported by accurate, convincing, clear evidence and at least some TMLR audience members should be interested in what was learned.

scientific_gates.rule: The work must contribute to understanding computational or mathematical principles enabling intelligence through learning within TMLR's stated scope.
The submission must be an original archival contribution under TMLR's dual-submission and reuse policy; this is distinct from requiring a novel method.
Claims are supported by accurate, convincing evidence.
The narrative and arguments are clear enough to establish the claims.

novelty_gate.rule: Novelty of the studied method is not a necessary acceptance criterion; incorrect novelty claims can still violate accuracy or originality requirements.

impact_gate.rule: Significance, impact, and new state-of-the-art performance are not acceptance gates.

breadth_gate.rule: Broad significance is handled by optional certifications, not ordinary acceptance.

audience_interest_gate.rule: It is enough that some individuals in TMLR's audience would be interested in what the paper teaches.

burden_of_doubt.rule: A reviewer unsure whether the audience-interest criterion is satisfied should generally assume that it is.

allowed_repair_routes.constraint: Add only evidence needed to support the stated claim; more experiments are not automatic.
Reduce the claim until the existing accurate evidence supports it.
Clarity repair cannot substitute for missing evidence.
A significantly revised paper is a new submission linked to the rejected submission; revealing author identity on the rejected record precludes that route.

review_model.triage: An Action Editor may desk reject with Editor-in-Chief approval or assign at least three reviewers.
review_model.review_independence: Reviews stay hidden from the public and other reviewers until all initial reviews are submitted; discussion then becomes public.
review_model.vote_rule: Reviewer recommendations inform but do not mechanically determine the Action Editor decision.
review_model.revision_model: Authors may respond and update the paper during discussion; rejected papers may be revised and resubmitted as new linked submissions.

ai_confidentiality_policy.author_ai_use: LLMs may be assistive general-purpose tools, cannot be authors, and do not transfer author responsibility for plagiarism, fabrication, correctness, or integrity.
ai_confidentiality_policy.reviewer_ai_use: Reviewers may use LLMs as assistance but must read the paper, form their own understanding and opinion, take responsibility, and write a review reflecting that opinion.
ai_confidentiality_policy.confidentiality: No general external-LLM confidentiality permission was located in the reviewed exact pages; double-blind and staged public-review rules apply, so unpublished content processing remains unresolved pending a live check.

schemes.rule: Editorial-board certification for exceptionally high-quality, broadly significant papers; it may be awarded well after publication.
Certification for very high-quality, significant, novel, well-explained and well-supported papers.
Certification for reproduction-focused papers adding substantial baselines, analysis, ablations, or insights beyond verification.
Certification for accepted survey papers that are exceptionally thorough or insightful.
Certification based on reviewer and Action Editor responses for eligibility to participating NeurIPS, ICLR, or ICML journal-to-conference tracks.
Certification recognizing accepted papers authored by highly rated TMLR reviewers; it is not a manuscript acceptance criterion.

certification_layer.notes: Do not import certification-level novelty, impact, or breadth into the ordinary acceptance objective.
